children: On August 27, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it no longer satisfies Listing Rule 5550(b)(2) because its market value of listed securities was below $35 million for 30 consecutive business days ended August 25, 2026. The deficiency could lead to delisting; the company has seven days to submit a compliance plan to the Nasdaq Hearings Panel and intends to do so.
